mapper.sql: d.id, d.user_id, d.name, d.layer_one_json, d.layer_two_json, d.selected, d.created_at, d.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM user_etching_design d INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username} ORDER BY d.selected DESC, d.updated_at DESC, d.id DESC
SELECT FROM user_etching_design d WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.selected = TRUE LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_etching_design d INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE u.username = #{username}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_etching_design (user_id, name, layer_one_json, layer_two_json, selected, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{layerOneJson}, #{layerTwoJson}, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE d FROM user_etching_design d INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = d.user_id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND u.username = #{username}
mapper.update: UPDATE user_etching_design d INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = d.user_id SET d.selected = FALSE WHERE u.username = #{username} AND d.selected = TRUE
UPDATE user_etching_design d INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = d.user_id SET d.selected = TRUE WHERE d.id = #{id} AND u.username = #{username}
